newsitem.title: USA: Santander adjusts Peru short-, long-term view.
newsitem.headline: Santander adjusts Peru short-, long-term view.

text.p: Santander Securities said on Tuesday it had downgraded its 12-month country allocation recommendation for Peru, but upgraded its short-term stance.
The brokerage wrote in an analysis it had lowered Peru to market weight from overweight in its 12-month country allocation recommendation.
For its three-month outlook, Santander upgraded Peru to stable from negative. All other country stances were unchanged.
